# Technavio

> > Technavio provides comprehensive market research reports and industry analysis across technology, healthcare, chemicals, energy, consumer goods, and industrial sectors worldwide.

Technavio delivers detailed market forecasts, growth analysis, and segmentation studies covering global markets with particular focus on APAC, North America, Europe, China, India, and Germany. Reports span 2024-2029 forecast periods and analyze emerging technologies including IoT, AI, automation, and sustainability trends across diverse industries.
